intent: Eight individual tasks preserve empty contents, repeated cleanliness requirements, placement, conditional ease, contextual difficulty, explanation scope, unequal amounts and simultaneous arrival.
picturePurpose: Original complete glass jars distinguish an empty interior from visible seed contents. Coded water levels let learners make either side larger: only unequal positive sample amounts matter, with no measured watering advice.

transfer.stem: Which report matches the club visit?
transfer.passage:
A Saturday with the gardening club
Before we left, Ms Chen asked us to keep an empty jar for seeds. We put it in our bag without filling it. At the garden, we tasted the soup we had made and used a clean spoon each time. When we went indoors, we left our dirty boots on the mat by the door.
A simple drawing explained the whole planting process. The first step was easy if we followed the diagram, so I looked at it before starting. Later, my fingers were cold and I found a knot difficult to undo. I put the rope aside and warmed my hands.
The club kept two kinds of seed. Their water requirements were different, but the drawing gave no figures and did not say which needed more. On our way home, my friend took the upper path and I took the lower one. We reached the bridge at the same time and walked the rest of the way together.

options.text: The diagram helped make the first step easy; the two kinds of seed needed unequal water amounts; the friends reached the bridge together.
Every step was easy without the diagram; the two kinds of seed needed unequal water amounts; the friends reached the bridge together.
The diagram helped make the first step easy; both kinds of seed needed exactly the same water amount; the friends reached the bridge together.
The diagram helped make the first step easy; the two kinds of seed needed unequal water amounts; the friends reached the bridge at different times.

answer.display: The diagram helped make the first step easy; the two kinds of seed needed unequal water amounts; the friends reached the bridge together.

explanation.strategy: 核对容易的条件、水量差异和到达时间。

steps.reason: if保留照图的条件；different说明量不一样，不提供哪种更多或倍数。

steps.text: 朋友们同时到桥边，不是先后到达。
steps.reason: at the same time表示同时；原文没给具体钟点或每天的频率。

distractors.reason: 把照图时第一步容易扩大成不看图每一步都容易。
把不同水量反转成完全相等。
把同时到达换成不同时间到达。

explanation.pitfall: 把有条件的容易扩大成全部容易，或混淆different与same。
